title: Consular Interview Appointment
description: Schedule a formal interview appointment at the US Embassy or Consulate.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa interview scheduling specialist. Help the applicant select an available Embassy or Consulate, date, and time for their visa interview.

fields.label: Embassy / Consulate City
fields.hint: City of the US Embassy or Consulate where the interview will be held.

fields.label: Embassy / Consulate
fields.hint: Specific Embassy or Consulate in the selected city.

fields.label: Interview Date
fields.hint: Select an available date for the consular interview.

fields.label: Interview Time Slot
fields.hint: Select an available time slot for the consular interview.

fields.label: Interview Confirmation Number
fields.hint: The confirmation number issued after booking the consular interview.

completion_message: Consular interview appointment confirmed. Proceed to generate and download your confirmation documents.
